response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT s.telescref AS telescope, o.weathprofile AS weathprofile, s.modindex AS modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg AS phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM linked), grp AS (SELECT telescope, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM linked GROUP BY telescope, weathprofile) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_mod) AS avg_modulation_index, AVG(g.avg_phase) AS avg_phase_shift, AVG(g.avg_mod - ov.overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall ov WHERE g.avg_mod > ov.overall_avg GROUP BY g.weathprofile
